title: 그 카페에 네가 있을 줄은
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement is centered on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A warm, fretless electric bass enters with melodic slides. Acoustic guitar provides light strumming in the background. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance is intimate with breathy delivery in the lower register, transitioning to a resonant chest voice. High-frequency reverb is applied to the vocals and piano to create a spacious acoustic environment.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[grand piano playing sustained chords]

[Verse 1]
[intimate male vocals]
명절 전날 오후였지 [acoustic guitar enters]
안방 장롱을 다 닦다 [fretless bass enters with a slide]
맨 위 칸에 손이 닿는데
낡은 봉투 하나 거기 있었어
아버지 글씨더라
잉크 색이 기억났어 [piano melodic fill]
